standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the presentation and the criterion applied on both sides.

standard_prerequisites.name: Torsion freeness is preserved by flat base change
standard_prerequisites.use: Keeps the quotient torsion free after base change.

core_obligations: Choose the presentation of the reflexive module with finite free middle term and torsion free quotient (proof lines 5340-5342).
Use flatness to keep the sequence exact after base change (proof lines 5343-5345).
Note that the middle term stays finite free and the quotient stays torsion free (proof lines 5346-5347).
Apply the reflexivity criterion to the base changed module (proof lines 5347-5348).
proof_roadmap: Presentation of the reflexive module (proof lines 5340-5342).
Base change keeps the shape (proof lines 5343-5347).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a finite reflexive module over a Noetherian domain stays finite reflexive after a flat base change along a homomorphism of Noetherian domains. The proof uses the criterion that a finite module is reflexive exactly when it sits in a short exact sequence with a finite free middle term and a torsion free quotient, chooses such a presentation, and observes that flatness preserves the shape of the sequence: the middle term stays finite free and the quotient stays torsion free, so the criterion applies to the base changed module.
